_note: Lighting variants for the golden-hour shot (Phase 0 milestone 5). Read by tools/ue/lighting.py. Sun: elevation above the horizon, azimuth = world yaw of the direction TOWARD the sun (UE yaw: 0 = +X, 90 = +Y). The main building facade and the front gates face +X, so azimuth near 0 front-lights them and azimuth near 60-90 rakes across them. intensity_lux is the atmosphere sun light (UE multiplies it by the atmosphere transmittance). Exposure is LOCKED: auto exposure min = max = exposure_ev100 (project uses ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange, so those are EV100), identical for every frame of a variant; critique rounds are comparable. Interiors are exposure-neutral by construction: they sit on lighting channel 1, the sun and sky-leak are kept off them, and a private interior key light (lighting channel 1 only) brings them to the same EV as the exterior, so no per-pocket exposure volume (which would pop at door transitions) is needed. ROUND 2 (critic CRITIQUE_R1): B_raking_amber is the winner and the only variant tuned; A and C keep their round-1 definitions (they pick up the global interior block but are not rendered). New optional per-variant blocks: sky.lower_hemisphere_rgb (warm bounce), clouds (volumetric cloud MI params), foliage_glow (emissive = albedo*gain on leaf cards, backlit-leaf transmission), post.extra. Global: interior.lights (channel-1 rect/point lights), interior.window_glow, interior.floor, shot_hides (importer-artifact actors hidden for the hero shots).
